subject: Hosted API: Quarterly commit uplift & rate recalibration — Quartic.AI
messages:
From: Derek Liu <derek@quartic.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quartic.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commit uplift — quick ask

Hey Ben,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're planning a Q2 feature launch that will push our token consumption up significantly. Can we explore bumping our hosted API monthly commit from 18M tokens to 30M for the next 6 months?

Two asks from our side:
- Can you send an updated pricing band for 30M (and an intermediate 24M) with expected unit rates and any change to soft-throttle behavior?
- We need to confirm whether existing rate limits per-route will be adjusted or whether we should request a higher per-minute burst window.

We want to move quickly — procurement is involved and would like a proposed amendment to review by EOD Wednesday. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Derek Liu
Head of Product
Quartic.AI

--
Attachment: usage-snapshot-q1.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Derek Liu <derek@quartic.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift — quick ask

Derek — thanks for the note and congrats on the launch prep. We can definitely support a temporary uplift; I sketched the options below so procurement has something concrete.

Summary options (monthly commit):
- 24M tokens: 6% unit discount vs. current 18M band; no change to per-route limits; recommended for moderate smoothing.
- 30M tokens: 11% unit discount; per-route soft-throttle raised by 30% by default; we can also add a 5-minute burst window option for traffic spikes.

Operational notes:
- Bump is effective on signing an amendment; provisioning time is 48-72 hours for hosted pools.
- We surface token-level cost and latency across routes in Console; recommend enabling the throughput alert we ship for early detection.

I'll pull together a formal amendment and the rateband spreadsheet (attached). Looping Kim and Karthik to confirm the per-route and burst mechanics.

If procurement needs a specific billing proration, let me know — we can pro-rate the month of change.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Draft_Ratebands_Quartic_2027.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 12:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift — quick ask

Ben / team — quick internal:
- Per-route behavior: default soft-throttle bump will increase steady-state per-route token/sec by 30% for the 30M band. This is implemented via our routing policy and doesn't change customer-visible per-minute quotas unless they opt into the burst window.
- Burst window: we can add a 5-minute burst slice (token credit buffer) tied to the month commit; it's billable at the amended unit rate and capped to prevent long tail overage.
- SLA/credits: no SLA changes for a temporary uplift; for >90-day committed changes we'll update the SLA cadence in the contract addendum.

I'll prepare the short ops note (provisioning checklist) and include the exact provisioning ETA.

Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Derek Liu <derek@quartic.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quartic.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift — quick ask

Thanks Ben — that framing helps. Procurement had two follow-ups:
1) For the 30M option, can you confirm the monthly minimum commitment term (we prefer 6 months) and the early-exit proration approach?
2) They asked whether any additional compliance review is required if we enable the burst window.

We'd like the 30M for three months as a ramp, then re-evaluate. Can you send an amendment that:
- sets a 3-month trial at 30M (same unit rate as 6-month commitment),
- includes a 5-minute burst window option,
- includes language for a 30-day notice to revert to prior band.

If you can get that draft by EOD Tuesday we can route to Procurement.

Best,
Derek
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Derek Liu <derek@quartic.ai>, Procurement <procurement@quartic.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift — quick ask

Derek / Procurement team — attached is the formal amendment and a short provisioning checklist (see attachments). Key points called out in the amendment: 
- Term: 3-month trial at 30M monthly commit (QRT-2027-1194). Pricing: unit rates aligned to the 30M band; no additional uplift for the burst window.
- Burst: 5-minute burst window enabled per account, billable at amended rate, capped at 15% of monthly commit per calendar month.
- Early exit: 30-day notice to revert; month-of proration applied to the next billing cycle with any overage reconciled on final invoice.
- Compliance: no new compliance documentation required for the burst window; existing SOC2 scope and audit trail will cover the change. If Procurement needs evidence, we can produce the audit-log extract for the provisioning event.

Action items:
- Procurement: please confirm legal contact for the amendment signature and whether you want DocuSign or PDF sign-and-return.
- Tech ops (cc): confirm provisioning window once signature is inbound — target 48 hours.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the amendment if helpful.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Quartic_HostedCommit_Proposal_v1.pdf, Throughput_Ratebands_2027.xlsx
